text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Sprinters Stakes, the
second G1
sprint race on our list.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This race is only 1,200 meters, just short
of a
mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Meanin' I can throw caution to the wind
and gun
it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, the steep hill right
before the
Nakayama Racecourse's finish
line calls for a lot
of power. Which
means...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
choice_data_list: 君の魅力を見せつける最高の舞台だ！
貴方の魅力を見せつける最高の舞台だよ！
choice_data_list_en: This is the perfect stage to show off your charm!
This is the perfect stage to show off your charm!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to power and speed, I'm
the best
around! I'll prove it to ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So you'd better start plannin' for a party,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll be back in a jiff!
choice_data_list_en: Come back across the line in first place!
Make sure you come back across the line in first!
